name: kw_archive_writer
reason: Open decision 3, settled by the user: the KWA archive format is no longer needed. It was the only VXL user left in kwiver's sprokit processes, writing through VXL's vsl binary serialisation, so keeping it would have meant reproducing that format byte for byte. configs/pipelines/filter_to_kwa.pipe existed only to write one and is deleted; the five indexing and query pipelines that also wrote an archive alongside their real work keep working without it.
